name: Li-S Energy
summary: Li-S Energy Limited, an Australian enterprise, is focused on pioneering and bringing to market cutting-edge lithium-sulfur battery technology. These advanced power solutions are engineered for a broad spectrum of applications, including electric and e-mobility vehicles, defense and law enforcement, aerospace, unmanned aerial systems (drones), and the consumer electronics and Internet of Things (IoT) sectors. The firm was established in 2019 and maintains its principal office in Brisbane, Australia.
